title.narrative: Programa de Inversiones en Agua Potable y Saneamiento Rural
Rural Water Investment Program

description.narrative: TO INCREASE COVERAGE OF POTABLE WATER AND SANITATION SERVICES IN RURAL AREAS IN A WAY THAT IS CONSISTENT WITH THE GOVERNMENT'S OBJECTIVES FOR MANAGING THE SECTOR. IT WILL SUPPORT AUTONOMOUS WATER COMMITTEES, OR OTHER LEGALLY CONSTITUTED, COMMUNITY-BASED ORGANIZATIONS, COOPERATIVES OR MICRO-ENTERPRISES CREATED TO PROVIDE THESE SERVICES. THE PROGRAM WILL FUND THE CAPITAL COSTS OF WATER AND SANITATION PROJECTS WITH A COMBINATION OF LOAN AND GRANT.
